## Why

README.md:19-26 says the planned `--blackline <id>` interface from issue #15 is not implemented because no persisted comparison-ID lookup contract connects ingest (#8) and blackline (#10). Verified current state: `src/doc_lineage/cli.py:49` defines `--blackline` as `store_true` and requires `--original`/`--modified`, so an ID-only invocation exits 2. `ingest_document` (`src/doc_lineage/ingest.py:242`) publishes segments and evidence, and `src/doc_lineage/blackline.py:30` produces in-memory section pairs and NDJSON edges; nothing persists a comparison that `export_docx_redline` (`src/doc_lineage/export/docx_redline.py:6`) can resolve. A user must resupply both paths every time and cannot reproduce an export against the exact bytes originally compared. This is a missing capability, not a regression.

Current source readback: `src/doc_lineage/cli.py:49` at `b9daca70b27f452d62d8c6ccdb3bcd3b5dc7a783` (file SHA-256 `7a109fd42eef1873b7976ab3894540c136c022270237c71467626ce47473b096`). Earlier detailed line ranges and reproductions retain their reviewed-commit provenance; intervening anchor changes were checked for relevance.

## Scope

- A versioned local comparison record (JSON on disk) binding an opaque comparison ID to ordered original/revised SHA-256 digests and retrievable DOCX input locations.
- A creation step and an ID lookup step wired into the `export-docx` CLI, with content verification at export time.
- The file-pair invocation keeps working.

## Non-Goals

- No hosted service, shared database or central document resolver.
- No PDF-to-DOCX conversion, renderer implementation, or new semantic section-matching algorithm in `src/doc_lineage/blackline.py`.
- Do not treat a filesystem path as a comparison ID, and do not reuse ingest run IDs as comparison IDs.
- Scaffold-only completion does NOT count: a record schema without a working ID-only export, or an ID path that skips byte-hash verification, does not close this issue.

## Tasks

- [ ] Add a "Comparison records" section to README.md (replacing the not-implemented paragraph at lines 19-26) defining the record fields, ID generation, store location and verification rules.
- [ ] In `src/doc_lineage/blackline.py` (after `emit_lineage_edges_ndjson`, line 188), add functions to write a record (ordered `original_sha256`, `modified_sha256`, input paths, schema version) and load by ID, raising `ValueError` for unknown IDs.
- [ ] In `src/doc_lineage/cli.py:49`, add a subcommand or option that creates a comparison from two DOCX paths and prints the ID; accept `--blackline <id>` on `export-docx` without breaking the boolean file-pair form.
- [ ] In `_run_export_docx` (`src/doc_lineage/cli.py:99`), resolve the ID, re-read both inputs, verify SHA-256 against the record, and pass bytes to `export_docx_redline`.
- [ ] Add tests to `tests/test_cli.py` covering create, new-process reopen, ID-only export, unknown ID, missing input and changed bytes.
- [ ] Extend `tests/export/test_docx_redline_golden.py:84` style assertions to check the ID-driven export reconstructs original and modified text when changes are rejected and accepted.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `pytest tests/test_cli.py -k comparison` passes: a comparison created from two synthetic DOCX files is reopened in a fresh invocation and exported by ID alone.
- [ ] Deliberate-break gate: temporarily skip the SHA-256 check in `_run_export_docx`; the changed-bytes comparison test in `tests/test_cli.py` must FAIL. Revert afterward.
- [ ] Passing a filesystem path as the `--blackline` value exits nonzero with a message that it is not a comparison ID.
- [ ] `pytest tests/test_cli.py` still passes, proving the file-pair form is unchanged, and README.md no longer says the ID workflow is not implemented.

## Implementation Notes

- `src/doc_lineage/cli.py:49`, `:99-117`, `:137-162`.
- `src/doc_lineage/ingest.py:242` (artifact publishing and `source_sha256`).
- `src/doc_lineage/blackline.py:30`, `:173-190`.
- `src/doc_lineage/export/docx_redline.py:6`.
- `src/doc_lineage/identity.py` for hashing conventions; `docs/contracts/document-identity-conventions.md` (Content-first identity).
- `tests/test_cli.py`, `tests/export/test_docx_redline_golden.py:84`.
- `tests/blackline/test_section_id_pairing.py:257`, `tests/ingest/test_ingest_synthetic_pdf.py:35`.
- README.md:19-26.
- Execution authority: the owner released the intake hold on 2026-10-16 (recorded decision, Claude Code campaign session). Auto-pilot, keepalive and runner assignment are permitted for this issue under the normal priority order.
- Accepted policy P08: retain distinct DOCX/package and extracted-PDF comparison modes with truthful fidelity claims; retain immutable original sources/manifests locally for replay, and report missing/deleted sources explicitly.
